predecessors.name: Habsburg monarchy
predecessors.text: Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia and Lusatia, the Lands of the Bohemian Crown that Cliopatria's Habsburg Monarchy shape of 1600 holds and its shape of 1619 does not

successors.name: Habsburg monarchy
successors.text: Bohemia, Moravia and Silesia, without Lusatia

successors.name: Electorate of Saxony
successors.text: Upper and Lower Lusatia (the part of the Bohemian Crown lands that lies in Saxony and Brandenburg)

ledger.x: 31 July 1619: the Estates of the Bohemian Crown form the Bohemian Confederacy against the Habsburgs.
8 November 1620: the Confederacy's army is destroyed at White Mountain.
November 1620: the Bohemian Confederacy ends with White Mountain.

wars.name: Bohemian Revolt
wars.outcome: Prague's third defenestration (23 May 1618) starts the revolt; the Confederacy forms on 31 July 1619, Frederick is elected king on 26 August 1619 and crowned on 4 November 1619; Saxony backs Ferdinand for Lusatia in July 1620 and occupies it in September…

certainty.note: No page gives the Confederacy's frontier or says how much of Moravia, Silesia and Lusatia its authorities held; the lands are the Crown's, the state a fifteen-month alliance of Estates.
